Verify pattern matched network conditions are applied.
Applies condtitions only to matching requests:
{
    appliedNetworkConditionsId : 0
    url : undefined
}
{
    appliedNetworkConditionsId : 1
    url : undefined
}
{
    appliedNetworkConditionsId : 1
    url : undefined
}
{
    appliedNetworkConditionsId : 0
    url : undefined
}
{
    appliedNetworkConditionsId : 0
    url : undefined
}
Applies conditions with named port group:
{
    appliedNetworkConditionsId : 2
    url : undefined
}
{
    appliedNetworkConditionsId : -1
    url : undefined
}
Applies global condtitions when no pattern is matching:
{
    appliedNetworkConditionsId : 3
    url : undefined
}
{
    appliedNetworkConditionsId : 3
    url : undefined
}
Rejects invalid patterns:
{
    error : {
        code : -32602
        message : Pattern "ht tp://*:*/*/a.html" failed to parse as a URLPattern.
    }
    id : <number>
    sessionId : <string>
}
{
    error : {
        code : -32602
        message : Pattern "*.html" failed to parse as a URLPattern.
    }
    id : <number>
    sessionId : <string>
}
{
    appliedNetworkConditionsId : 3
    url : undefined
}
{
    appliedNetworkConditionsId : 3
    url : undefined
}
